askMaya.question: What is the company size band used for in HR Clouds?

gst_number.hint: The company’s GST registration number. Only HR can see or change it.

askMaya.question: What is a GSTIN, what does each part of the 15-character number mean, and where does a company need to use it?

company_pan_number.hint: The company’s own income-tax number — not any employee’s PAN. It appears on the Form 16 given to employees.

askMaya.question: What is a company PAN, how is it different from a TAN, and where does it appear in salary tax documents like Form 16?

payroll.settlement.description: Final settlement record inspector (PayrollExitsPage › SettlementPanel) — the #224 statement download. Keys name the concept, as the statement has no response key of its own. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the Exits & Final Pay h1, `status` on the Stage column (the recorded → prepared → settled machine from the file header), and `period_month` (the ‘Pay it with’ month) in the settlement inspector.

settlement_statement.hint: Provisional until the final pay goes out in a payroll run: payouts and recoveries only. The final one adds the last month’s pay and what was paid.

askMaya.question: What goes into a full and final settlement, and why can a provisional statement differ from the final one?

page.hint: Record someone leaving, then work out their final pay — last month’s salary, unused leave paid out, short notice and loans recovered — and pay it in a payroll.

askMaya.question: What is a full and final settlement when an employee leaves, and what does it include?

status.hint: Recorded: last day on file, nothing worked out. Prepared: amounts fixed, waiting for a payroll. Settled: paid in an approved run.

askMaya.question: What are the stages of a final settlement, from recording an exit to paying it?

period_month.hint: The payroll month the final payment is added to. Once the settlement is prepared it’s fixed; undo it to change the month.

askMaya.question: Which payroll month should a leaver’s final payment be paid in?

payroll.run_payslips.description: Payslips & delivery panel on a payroll run (RunPayslipsPanel) — the two bank advice files (#181 CSV, #223 PDF).

bank_advice.hint: Upload the CSV to your bank to pay everyone. The PDF is a printable copy to sign and keep on file — account numbers are hidden, so a bank can’t use it.

askMaya.question: What is a bank advice file, and how is it used to pay salaries?

attendance.shift_setup.description: HR — Setup › Work Shifts (AttendanceShiftsPage): the shift and rotation dialogs, both lists and the shift record inspector. Concept keys: `page` (beside the h1), `rotations` (the Rotation Patterns heading). The policy thresholds in the inspector reuse attendance.policy_setup.

page.hint: A shift sets the hours people work. Its linked attendance policy then decides lateness, half days and overtime against those hours.

askMaya.question: What is a work shift, and how does it work with an attendance policy?

type.hint: Fixed has set start and end times. Flexible has none, so nobody on it is marked late. Night starts one day and ends the next.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between fixed, flexible and night shifts?

start_time.hint: Lateness is measured from the start time, after the policy’s grace period, and early exits from the end time. Get these wrong and people are marked late.

askMaya.question: How do shift start and end times decide lateness and early exits?

policy_id.hint: The rule book this shift is judged by — grace, full and half-day hours, overtime. With none linked, the default attendance policy applies.

askMaya.question: How does a shift’s attendance policy decide late arrivals, half days and overtime?

rotations.hint: A rotation moves people through several shifts on a repeating schedule — say a week of mornings, then a week of nights. Rest days come from Weekly Offs.

askMaya.question: What is a rotating shift pattern, and when do companies use one?

start_reference_date.hint: Day 1 of the first phase. The pattern counts forward from this date and repeats, so it decides which shift falls on every later day.

askMaya.question: How does the start date of a shift rotation decide which shift falls on each day?

entries.hint: Each phase is one shift worked for a run of days. Phases run in this order, then the cycle starts again from the first one.

askMaya.question: How are the phases of a shift rotation set up and repeated?

rotation_cycle_days.hint: How many days the whole pattern takes before it repeats — the phase lengths added together.

askMaya.question: How is the length of a shift rotation cycle worked out?

payroll.pdf_templates.description: HR — Payroll › Document Previews (PayrollPdfTemplatesPage). Sample renders of each payroll document with the org's live branding. Only the page itself is helped; the document list explains itself.

page.hint: Shows how each payroll document will print with your letterhead. The figures are made up — only the branding is real.

askMaya.question: What are document previews for, and why don't they show real employee pay?

organization.hr_job_fields.description: HR — Employee profile › Profile tab › Edit job details (HrJobFieldsDialog). The HR-only job record. Designation, employee code, gender and marital status are ordinary; the four that change how the system treats the person are helped. Contract: md_updates/2026-10-07_hr_fields_expansion_and_work_mode_update_apis.md §2.

work_mode.hint: Decides where their clock-ins are checked. Field staff are checked against client sites; remote staff aren’t checked against anywhere.

askMaya.question: What does each work mode change about how an employee's attendance is tracked?

location_id.hint: The office their attendance is measured against. Leave it unset and any active branch counts, which is usually not what you want.

askMaya.question: What happens to attendance if an employee has no base office set?

job_status.hint: Where they are in their employment — probation, confirmed, serving notice. Reports and some policies read this.

askMaya.question: What is job status used for across payroll and leave?

notice_period_started_on.hint: The day their notice began. Leave it empty unless they are actually serving notice — it feeds exit and final pay.

askMaya.question: When should I set the notice start date, and what does it affect?

attendance.field_locations.description: HR Setup › Client Sites and Manager › Client Sites (FieldLocationsView, shared). Name, client, city and address explain themselves; only what the term means and what the radius does are helped. Contract: md_attendance/7_work_mode_and_field_geofencing_api.md.

page.hint: Places outside your offices where field staff can clock in. Anyone assigned to one can punch there without being flagged.

askMaya.question: What is a client site, and how is it different from an office location?

geofence_radius_meters.hint: How far from the pin a clock-in still counts. Too tight and a large site flags honest punches; too wide and it stops meaning anything.

askMaya.question: How should I choose the distance allowed around a client site?

attendance.field_assignments.description: Assigning somebody to a client site, in both the HR and manager workspaces: the dialog on Client Sites (FieldLocationsView) and the same thing person-first in FieldAssignmentsPanel — the People view there, and the Reporting & Location tab on an employee record. Who may be assigned differs by role, and an open-ended window is the non-obvious part.

user_id.hint: Who you can assign depends on your role: HR can assign anyone, a manager only their own direct reports.

askMaya.question: Who is allowed to assign an employee to a client site?

effective_to.hint: Leave blank for no end date. Both dates count — the site stays valid on the last day, not up to it.

askMaya.question: What happens when a field assignment has no end date?

work_mode.hint: How their clock-ins are judged: Office checks their base office, Field also accepts the client sites below, Remote checks nothing.

askMaya.question: What does each work mode change about where an employee can clock in?

field_location_id.hint: Only active sites they aren’t already on appear here. A site they already have is left out — change its dates on the row instead of adding it twice.

askMaya.question: Why can an employee only be assigned to the same client site once?

geofence_radius_meters.hint: How far from this site’s pin a clock-in still counts. It belongs to the site, so it is changed on the site itself, not per person.

askMaya.question: Why does each client site have its own distance allowance?

attendance.my_work_locations.description: The self-service My Work Locations page (MyWorkLocationsPage, shared), mounted in all three workspaces — everyone punches, so everyone reads their own. Read-only: assigning sites is HR/manager-only. Office name, client and dates explain themselves; only the mode, what the page is for, and the radius are helped. Contract: md_attendance/7_work_mode_and_field_geofencing_api.md.

page.hint: The office and client sites you can clock in from. Clock in far from all of them and the punch still works, but your manager sees it to review.

askMaya.question: Why does it matter where I clock in from?

work_mode.hint: How your clock-ins are location-checked: at your office, from client sites, anywhere (remote), or your choice each day (hybrid). HR sets this.

askMaya.question: What do the different work modes mean for where I can clock in?

geofence_radius_meters.hint: How far from a site you can clock in and still count as there. Clock in from further away and the punch still works but is flagged for review.

askMaya.question: What happens if I clock in outside a site’s allowed distance?

attendance.my_schedule.description: My Schedule & Rules (MySchedulePage), all three workspaces under SELF_SERVICE_PAGES.schedule. REBUILT AS FOUR TABS 22 Oct 2026 (user decision): the four stacked bands are now tabs in ?tab=, keyed tab.week / tab.shift / tab.rules / tab.team, with one ⓘ beside the tab strip for whichever is open. Per screen state: Next 7 days = page, tab.week, leave_days and items_due on the headline tiles (4; the deadline panel heading is the same concept as the items_due tile, so it carries no ⓘ); Working week = page, tab.shift, weekly_offs, matched_by (4); How days are counted = page, tab.rules, policy, full_day_min_hours on the grading ladder (4); Who’s in = page, tab.team, working_count (3). grace_minutes, max_break_duration_minutes, regularization_window_days, overtime_enabled and auto_clock_out_enabled are PARKED, not wired: each rule card prints its own rule in plain words beside the figure, and six card hints put that tab five over the cap. Written to the person about their own schedule, so none of these is reused on a screen about somebody else; the team tab is neutral because a manager and HR both read it.

page.hint: The hours you’re expected to work and the rules your days are counted by. HR sets both; this is where you check how a day of yours is judged.

askMaya.question: Where do my shift and my attendance rules come from, and what should I do if they look wrong?

tab.week.hint: Your next seven days, the figures they add up to, and anything falling due inside them. Days off and holidays are shown as they come.

askMaya.question: What does my schedule take into account when it works out my next seven days?

tab.shift.hint: The hours you’re expected to work, the cycle they move on, and your regular days off. HR sets all three — ask them if something looks wrong.

askMaya.question: Who decides my shift and my days off, and what should I do if they’re wrong?

tab.rules.hint: The rules your clock-ins are measured against: how long you may arrive after your start time, what makes a full day, and how far back a fix can be asked for.

askMaya.question: Where do the rules my attendance is measured against come from?

tab.team.hint: How much of your team is expected in each day of the week, and who is already away. Only the people who report to you.

askMaya.question: What does team cover tell me, and who is counted in it?

leave_days.hint: Only the days actually taken off your balance. A weekend or holiday inside a leave stretch isn’t counted here, because it was never deducted.

askMaya.question: Why is my leave count lower than the number of days I booked?

items_due.hint: Task deadlines, document dates and days off about to expire, grouped by the day they land on. Only the next seven days.

askMaya.question: What kinds of things show up as falling due on my schedule?

weekly_offs.hint: Your regular days off. Clocking in on one still records your work, but the day is counted separately instead of as a normal working day.

askMaya.question: What happens if I work on one of my weekly days off?

matched_by.hint: Which rule gives you these days off, and who else it covers. HR can set different days off for a department, a workplace, a shift or one person.

askMaya.question: Why might my weekly days off be different from a colleague’s in another team?

policy.hint: The rule set your clock-ins are measured against. Everyone on the same shift shares it, and the rules in force on a past day stay with that day.

askMaya.question: What is an attendance policy and who decides which one applies to me?

full_day_min_hours.hint: Time worked, with breaks taken off, needed for the day to count. Below the half-day figure the day isn’t counted as attendance at all.

askMaya.question: How are my hours worked turned into a full day, a half day or an absent day?

grace_minutes.hint: Extra time after your shift starts in which clocking in still counts as on time. Arrive after it and the day records a late arrival.

askMaya.question: How does a grace period work, and what happens to my attendance if I clock in after it?

max_break_duration_minutes.hint: The most break time and the most breaks you can take in a day. Break time is taken off your hours worked, so going over can cost you the day.

askMaya.question: What happens if I take more break time than my attendance policy allows?

regularization_window_days.hint: How far back you can ask for a missed or wrong punch to be fixed. Past that, only HR can change the day.

askMaya.question: How far back can I ask for an attendance correction, and what do I do once that window has closed?

overtime_enabled.hint: Whether extra time past a full day is recorded as overtime, and how much extra it takes before any of it counts.

askMaya.question: How is my overtime worked out, and why might extra hours I worked not show up as overtime?

auto_clock_out_enabled.hint: If you never clock out, your day is closed for you at this point. Your real hours are lost, so clock out even when you leave late.

askMaya.question: What happens to my attendance if I forget to clock out?

working_count.hint: How many of your team are expected in each day. Someone on a half day counts as both in and away, so the figures can total more than your team.

askMaya.question: How is team cover worked out when someone takes a half day?

attendance.weekly_off_setup.description: HR — Setup › Weekly Offs (AttendanceWeeklyOffsPage): the rule dialog, both rule tables and the rule record inspector. Only priority is helped; days, dates and targeting explain themselves on screen.

priority.hint: Someone two rules cover gets only the days off of the rule with the higher number. Give a narrower group’s rule a higher number than the company-wide one.

askMaya.question: What happens when two weekly-off rules cover the same employee?

organization.office_locations.description: HR Setup › Office Locations and Manager › Organisation › Office Locations (OfficeLocationsView, shared). Name, address and city explain themselves. `page` sits beside the h1 and is HR-only onboarding help — the subtitle already says what the screen is for. The radius is core, NOT onboarding, because the manager's page is read-only reference and it is the one figure on a card that isn't self-evident; that workspace gets no other hint here. Contract: md_organization/3_org_structure_api.md (POST/PUT are HR-only, so the manager page has no Add button or status switch).

page.hint: Your workplaces, each with a pin and a distance around it. People can clock in from inside that circle without being flagged.

askMaya.question: What is an office location used for, and how is it different from a client site?

geofence_radius_meters.hint: How far from the pin someone can clock in. Further out, the clock-in still counts but is flagged for review as outside the office.

askMaya.question: What is a clock-in radius, and what happens when someone clocks in outside it?

organization.location_setup.description: HR — Setup › Office Locations (AttendanceLocationsPage), the location dialog. Name and address are ordinary; the two fields attendance reads are helped. Out-of-bounds clock-ins are accepted and flagged (ATTENDANCE_MODULE_AUDIT, Punches).

timezone.hint: The office’s local time zone. Clock-ins here are read in it, so a wrong zone moves everyone’s start time and can mark a whole office late.

askMaya.question: Why does an office location need the right time zone for attendance?

geofence_radius_meters.hint: How far from the pin someone can clock in. Further out, the clock-in still counts but is flagged for review as outside the office.

askMaya.question: What is a clock-in radius, and what happens when someone clocks in outside it?

leaves.type_setup.description: HR — Setup › Leave Types (LeaveTypesPage): the type dialog, the list headers and the type record inspector. `page` sits beside the h1. Name, description, the document threshold and who-can-apply explain themselves. `is_system` renders only on the platform-owned comp-off type, in the inspector beside its code.

page.hint: The kinds of leave people can ask for, such as sick or casual leave. How many days each person gets of each is set in Leave Policies, not here.

askMaya.question: What are leave types, and how are they different from leave policies?

code.hint: A short tag for this leave, used where the full name won’t fit — tables, balances and reports. Every leave type needs its own.

askMaya.question: What is a leave code used for?

is_system.hint: Comp-off is credited against this type, so we set it up and keep it. You can rename it and change its rules, but not switch it off.

askMaya.question: Why is the compensatory off leave type set up by the system instead of created by HR, and what can I still change about it?

is_paid.hint: Off makes every day of this leave an unpaid day, taken off that month’s pay. Leave people are given each year is normally paid.

askMaya.question: What is leave without pay, and how do unpaid leave days reduce a month’s salary?

sandwich_rule_applies.hint: On, a weekend that falls between two leave days counts as leave too. Friday and Monday off would then use four days, not two.

askMaya.question: What is the sandwich rule for leave, and why do some companies apply it?

leaves.automation.description: HR — Setup › Leave Automation (LeaveAutomationPage). Concept keys: `page` (beside the h1), `accrual` and `rollover` (the two card titles), `rollover.reference_date` (the rollover card’s date — the same API key as the accrual one, but it picks a year, not a month). `reference_date` is the accrual card’s payload key.

page.hint: Both jobs run by themselves on schedule. Run one here only to catch up after a missed run — each skips anyone it has already handled.

askMaya.question: How do the automatic leave jobs work, and when should they be run by hand?

accrual.hint: Adds one month’s leave days to everyone’s balance. It runs by itself on the 1st; run it here only to catch up — anyone already credited is skipped.

askMaya.question: How does monthly leave credit work?

reference_date.hint: The run acts as if today were this date, so it credits that date’s month. Leave it empty to use today.

askMaya.question: What does the reference date do when running the monthly leave credit by hand?

rollover.hint: Closes the old leave year: unused days up to each policy’s kept-for-next-year limit move across, the rest are lost, and the new year’s days begin.

askMaya.question: What happens to unused leave at the end of the leave year, and what does carrying leave forward mean?

rollover.reference_date.hint: The run acts as if today were this date, which decides which leave year is closed. Leave it empty to use today.

askMaya.question: What does the reference date do when running the year-end leave rollover by hand?

payroll.automation.description: HR — Setup › Payroll Automation (PayrollAutomationPage). Every job card already says what it does and does not do; only the page itself (`page`, beside the h1) is helped.

page.hint: Background jobs that run by themselves on a schedule. Run one here only when it’s needed now — a second run never emails anyone twice or opens another draft.

askMaya.question: What do the automatic payroll jobs do, and when should one be run by hand?

documents.type_setup.description: HR — Setup › Document Types (DocumentTypesPage). The type dialog explains every switch in its own words, so only the page (`page`, beside the h1) and the two tabs (`tab.ours`, `tab.catalog`, one ⓘ beside the tablist) are helped.

page.hint: Every kind of document the company collects from people or issues to them. A type has to be active here before anyone can upload it or HR can issue it.

askMaya.question: What are document types, and why must one be active before it can be used?

tab.ours.hint: The types this organisation uses. Open one to change who can see it, whether HR checks it, and whether people are required to provide it.

askMaya.question: How do I set who can see a document type and whether employees must provide it?

tab.catalog.hint: Standard types HR Clouds ships with. Activate the ones needed and they join Our document types, where their rules can be changed.

askMaya.question: What is the document type catalog, and how do I activate types from it?

documents.form_library.description: HR — Setup › Form Templates (TemplateLibraryPage). The tiles and states explain themselves; only the page is helped.

page.hint: Blank company forms people download and fill in — claim sheets, declarations, nominations. Publishing a new version takes the old one out of circulation.

askMaya.question: What are form templates, and how does publishing a new version work?

documents.automation.description: HR — Setup › Document Automation (DocumentAutomationPage). Each routine card says what it does; only the page is helped.

page.hint: Overnight jobs that send the day’s reminders, record expired documents and clear old files. Running one here only does it early — nothing breaks if it waits.

askMaya.question: What do the overnight document jobs do?

documents.letterhead.description: HR — Setup › Letterhead & Branding (LetterBrandingPage). `page` beside the h1; the four registration numbers are wired by the BRANDING_GROUPS field key, so the config decides which carry an ⓘ.

page.hint: The frame around every letter the company issues: header, footer, address, registration numbers and who signs. Set it once and every new letter uses it.

askMaya.question: What goes on a company letterhead, and where is it used?

cin.hint: The number the company is registered under as a company. It is on the certificate of incorporation.

askMaya.question: What is a Company Identification Number (CIN), and where can a company find its own?

gstin.hint: The company’s GST registration number, from its GST certificate. It is only printed on letters; it changes nothing on payslips.

askMaya.question: What is a GSTIN, what does each part of the 15-character number mean, and where does a company need to use it?

pan.hint: The company’s own income-tax number — not any employee’s PAN. It is on the company’s PAN card.

askMaya.question: What is a company PAN, how is it different from a TAN, and where does it appear in salary tax documents like Form 16?

tan.hint: The number the company deposits income tax cut from salaries under. It also appears on employees’ Form 16.

askMaya.question: What is a TAN, and why does an employer need one to deduct tax from salaries?

documents.letter_templates.description: HR — Setup › Letter Templates (LetterTemplatesPage). Only the page is helped; tiles and states explain themselves.

page.hint: The standard letters the company can issue. Switch on the ones used and add the wording that stays the same in every copy; the rest is filled in per person.

askMaya.question: How do letter templates work, and what wording can the company set?

payroll.claims_admin.description: HR — Payroll › Claims (PayrollReimbursementsPage): the tab strip (`tab.claims` / `tab.categories`, one ⓘ beside the tabs), the claims queue’s Pay month column, and the expense-category dialog, list and record inspector. The per-claim decision dialog is covered by payroll.claim_review (shared with managers).

tab.claims.hint: Every expense claim in the organisation. Approved claims are paid back with salary, in the pay month shown on each one.

askMaya.question: How are expense claims reviewed and paid back with salary?

tab.categories.hint: The kinds of expense people can claim, each with its own limits, receipt rule and tax treatment. Changes apply only to claims made from now on.

askMaya.question: How should expense claim categories and their limits be set up?

period_month.hint: The payroll an approved claim is paid in. If that month’s payroll is already approved, it moves to a later month, as set in Payroll Settings.

askMaya.question: Which pay month is an approved expense claim paid in?

is_taxable.hint: Taxable claims are paid as income, so income tax is worked out on them. Non-taxable ones are paid on top of salary with no tax.

askMaya.question: Which employee reimbursements are taxable and which are tax-free?

limit_period.hint: What the period limit resets over. A financial year runs from April to March, not January to December.

askMaya.question: What is the Indian financial year, and why does it run from April to March?

component_id.hint: The payslip line approved claims in this category are paid through. Left empty, payroll picks one itself.

askMaya.question: How are approved expense claims shown on a payslip?

payroll.loan_admin.description: HR — Payroll › Loans & Advances (PayrollLoansPage): `page` beside the h1, the grant dialog’s interest method (payroll.loans.interest_method is written to the employee, so HR gets its own), `outstanding` (derived: principal less recovered) on the list and inspector, and the foreclose dialog’s settlement mode.

page.hint: Company loans and salary advances, paid back in monthly instalments taken from salary. The repayment schedule is worked out when the loan is granted.

askMaya.question: How do company loans and salary advances work for employees?

interest_method.hint: Flat charges interest on the full amount for the whole loan. Reducing charges it only on what’s still owed, so the employee pays less in total.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between flat interest and reducing-balance interest on a loan?

outstanding.hint: What is still to be repaid: the amount lent, less the instalments already taken from salary.

askMaya.question: How is the amount still owed on an employee loan worked out?

settlement_mode.hint: Recover via payroll takes everything still owed from salary in the month chosen. Settled externally closes the loan with nothing taken from pay.

askMaya.question: How can an employee loan be closed early, and how is the rest recovered?

attendance.lock_periods.description: HR — Payroll › Lock Attendance (AttendanceLockPeriodsPage): `page` beside the h1 and `source` on the lock table. Payroll-created locks are the ones that reopen a paid month when removed (the isPayrollLock comment).

page.hint: Locking a date range freezes its attendance so it can’t change while payroll is worked out. An approved payroll run locks its own month as well.

askMaya.question: Why is attendance locked before payroll, and what does a lock stop?

source.hint: Payroll run locks were made when a payroll was approved — unlocking one reopens a month already paid. Manual locks were added here by HR.

askMaya.question: What happens if an attendance lock made by a payroll run is removed?

payroll.runs.description: HR — Payroll › Payroll Runs (PayrollRunDashboard): `page` beside the h1, `status` on the Show filter (the RUN_STATUS_META machine, one line), and `readiness` on the start dialog’s readiness panel. Each run card already carries its own status hint.

page.hint: Each month’s salaries: start a run, calculate it, check the results, approve it, then mark it paid once the bank transfer is done.

askMaya.question: What are the steps of running monthly payroll?

status.hint: Draft, then Ready for review, Approved and Paid. Approving freezes the figures and locks the month’s attendance; Paid means salaries were sent.

askMaya.question: What do the stages of a payroll run mean, and what does approving freeze?

readiness.hint: Who can be paid this month. Anyone with no salary structure or no last working day shows as a problem after calculating — fix or exclude them before approving.

askMaya.question: What needs to be ready before a monthly payroll run can be approved?

payroll.run_summary.description: HR — Payroll › a run › the summary blocks under the totals (VARIABLE_PAY_FIELDS, STATUTORY_FIELDS, PAYOUT_FIELDS in runMeta.js). Wired by field key; the config decides which tiles carry an ⓘ.

clamped_item_count.hint: People whose deductions came to more than their pay. Their pay was set to ₹0 and what couldn’t be taken moves to a later month.

askMaya.question: What happens when an employee’s deductions are more than their pay in a month?

pt_unresolved_count.hint: People with no professional tax worked out — usually no slab for their state. Add it in Tax & Legal Deductions and recalculate.

askMaya.question: Why might professional tax not be worked out for some employees?

pan_missing_count.hint: People with no PAN on file. Their income tax is cut at the higher no-PAN rate until their PAN is added.

askMaya.question: What happens to income tax when an employee hasn’t given their PAN?

carry_forward_generated_total.hint: Deductions there wasn’t enough pay left to take this month. They move to a later payroll instead of being written off.

askMaya.question: How are deductions carried over to a later payroll recovered?

payroll.payslip_admin.description: HR — Payroll › Payslips & Documents (PayrollPayslipsPage) and a run’s Payslips & delivery panel (RunPayslipsPanel). `page` beside the h1; the tab strip (`tab.payslips` / `tab.annual` / `tab.form16`, one ⓘ beside the tablist); `version` and `is_visible` on both payslip tables; `active_only` beside the “Only current versions” tick box.

page.hint: Every payslip, yearly salary statement and Form 16 for one employee, including replaced versions. Payslips are frozen when a payroll run is approved.

askMaya.question: Which salary documents does an employee receive, and how are they kept?

tab.payslips.hint: Each month’s payslip. A reissue fixes a name or department — never a figure — and the replaced copy is kept as history.

askMaya.question: What does reissuing a payslip change, and what can it never change?

tab.annual.hint: Everything paid to the person across one financial year, month by month, in a single statement.

askMaya.question: What is an annual salary statement, and what does it show?

tab.form16.hint: The yearly certificate of income tax taken from the person’s salary. They need it to file their own tax return.

askMaya.question: What is Form 16, what do Part A and Part B show, and why does an employee need it?

version.hint: Version 1 is the payslip made at approval. Each reissue adds a new version; only the latest is current.

askMaya.question: Why can a payslip have more than one version?

is_visible.hint: Employees see a payslip only once it’s released — at approval, or by HR from the run when release on approval is switched off.

askMaya.question: When can employees see their payslips, and how does releasing them work?

active_only.hint: On by default, so each month shows the payslip that counts now. Untick it to also see versions that were replaced or withdrawn.

askMaya.question: What is a current payslip version, and why are the older ones kept?

payroll.salary_approvals.description: HR — Payroll › Salary Approvals (PayrollApprovalsPage): the queue of manager-proposed salary changes. `page` beside the h1.

page.hint: Salary changes proposed by managers or another HR admin, waiting for approval. Approving applies the new pay from its effective date; rejecting changes nothing.

askMaya.question: How are proposed salary changes approved, and when does the new pay start?

organization.employee_profile.description: HR — People › Team › an employee’s profile (EmployeeProfilePage): one ⓘ beside the ProfileTabStrip (outside its scroll container) keyed `tab.<key>` for the open tab — only tabs whose job isn’t obvious from the label have an entry — and `given_taken` on the Leave tab’s Customise table.

tab.department.hint: Who they report to, the department they sit in, and where their clock-ins are allowed — their base office plus any client sites.

askMaya.question: What do an employee’s reporting line and work location decide for them?

department_id.hint: Which part of the organisation this person belongs to. It drives department headcount and reports, not who approves their leave — that is the reporting person.

askMaya.question: What does an employee’s department decide for them?

head_of_department_id.hint: Who runs the department this person sits in. It is set on the department itself, not on this record, so change it under Departments.

askMaya.question: How is a head of department different from a reporting person?

reporting_person.hint: Who approves this person’s leave and attendance and can see their records. Changing it moves those requests to somebody else.

askMaya.question: What changes for an employee when their reporting person is changed?

tab.tasks.hint: Work this person has been given, whoever gave it out, and whether any of it is waiting on your review or past its deadline.

askMaya.question: Which tasks appear on an employee’s record, and who is allowed to give them one?

tab.leave.hint: Their leave balances and policy. Assigning a policy replaces all their leave rules; Customise changes one leave type for them alone.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between assigning a leave policy and customising one person’s leave rules?

given_taken.hint: Given: days added this year so far, all at once or month by month. Taken: days already used.

askMaya.question: How is the leave given so far worked out, and how does it differ from leave taken?

attendance.roster.description: HR — Setup › Time › Shift Management (AttendanceRosterPage): `page` beside the h1. The assign dialog (AssignShiftDialog, also opened from Work Shifts) explains its own fields.

page.hint: Which shift or rotation each person follows, and from when. Lateness and hours are judged against it; with none, their attendance policy decides.

askMaya.question: How are shifts and rotations assigned to employees, and from when do they apply?

attendance.comp_off_queue.description: HR — Time & Leave › Earned Leave (AttendanceCompOffsPage): `page` beside the h1. The Credit and Expires columns reuse attendance.approval_queue.days_earned and attendance.comp_off_policy.validity_days.

page.hint: Days off earned by working a holiday or weekly off. Approving adds them to the person’s leave; they expire if not used in time.

askMaya.question: How is earned leave for working on an off day approved and used?

documents.compliance.description: HR — Documents We Collect › Document Compliance (DocumentCompliancePage): `requires` on the Asks for column and `waived` on the Excused column.

requires.hint: Acknowledge asks people to confirm they’ve read the document. Sign records a signature as well.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between acknowledging a document and signing it?

waived.hint: People HR has let off this document. They no longer count as still to do or overdue.

askMaya.question: What does excusing someone from a company document mean?

documents.search.description: HR — Documents We Collect › Find a Document (DocumentSearchPage): `status` on the State column and `tags` on the tag filter.

status.hint: In review: waiting for HR to check. Verified: checked, and it counts. Rejected: needs uploading again. Expired: past its expiry date.

askMaya.question: What do the document states in review, verified, rejected and expired mean?

tags.hint: HR’s own labels, such as audit-2026, for pulling the same set of documents again later.

askMaya.question: How can tags help find and group employee documents?

documents.letter_register.description: HR — Documents We Issue › Issued Letters (IssuedLettersPage): `reissue` on the Status column — a reissue never edits a letter (ReissueLetterDialog header).

reissue.hint: A letter is never edited. Reissuing marks the old one as replaced — it keeps its reference number — and issues a new version beside it.

askMaya.question: What happens when an issued letter is reissued, and why is the old one kept?

documents.org_documents.description: HR — Documents We Issue › Organisation Documents (OrgDocumentsPage): `page` beside the h1.

page.hint: Policies and notices sent to groups of people. Each can ask people to acknowledge or sign it; Document Compliance shows who has.

askMaya.question: How are company policies and notices issued to employees, and how is reading them tracked?

attendance.reports.description: HR — Insights › Attendance Reports (AttendanceReportsPage): `flagged` on the daily table. Late and Overtime reuse attendance.team.

flagged.hint: Days with something unusual — a missing punch, a clock-in outside the office, a break too long — for a manager or HR to review.

askMaya.question: What kinds of unusual attendance are flagged for review?

documents.reports.description: HR — Insights › Document Reports (ComplianceReportsPage): `completeness` on the missing-documents table.

completeness.hint: The share of this person’s required documents they have provided and HR has verified. Anything below the onboarding target shows as incomplete.

askMaya.question: How is an employee’s document completeness worked out?

documents.exports.description: HR — Insights › Document Exports (DocumentExportsPage): `page` beside the h1.

page.hint: Every bulk download of staff documents, and who took it. A download is refused if its entry here can’t be written, so this list is complete.

askMaya.question: Why is every bulk download of employee documents recorded?

documents.email_log.description: HR — Insights › Document Emails (DocumentEmailLogPage): `page` beside the h1. Queued is not sent — a separate sender empties the queue (file header).

page.hint: Every document email the system queued and what became of it. Queued isn’t sent — a separate sender works through the queue, so check here whether it went out.

askMaya.question: How are document emails sent, and how can I check whether one went out?

documents.form_template.description: HR — Setup › Form Templates › the new / edit / replace form dialog (shared TemplateFormDialog). The name, description and file are ordinary fields and get nothing; the two that are ours — which document type it is filed under, and whether the file lives here or at a link — are helped. The visibility switch explains itself in its own description.

document_type_id.hint: Groups the form with documents of that kind — and hides it from employees if that type is hidden from them. Most blank forms need none.

askMaya.question: What does filing a blank form under a document type change for the people who download it?

storage_backend.hint: Keep the file here, or point at a page elsewhere. A link stops working if that page moves, and this choice can’t be changed afterwards.

askMaya.question: When should a company form be uploaded and kept in the portal rather than linked to an external website?

leaves.assignment.description: HR → Setup → Leave → Leave Assignment (LeaveAssignmentPage): who is on which leave policy, who is on none. `page` beside the h1, `coverage` and `state` on their columns, `override_count` on the Custom Rules column and its tile, `effective_to` in the End dialog. The record inspector reuses leaves.policy_setup for the entitlement fields — do not write a second set of hints for the same concepts.

page.hint: Everyone in the organisation and the leave policy each one is on. Assigning a policy replaces the rules a person has and works their year out again.

askMaya.question: What does assigning a leave policy to someone actually change for them, and what happens to leave they have already taken?

coverage.hint: On a policy means their days come from one. Not recorded means they have leave but we never recorded which. No policy means they cannot apply at all.

askMaya.question: Why might an employee have leave rules without a leave policy recorded against them, and does that need fixing?

state.hint: Ongoing means the policy applies now. Upcoming means it starts later. Ended means a last day was set, so no leave can be taken after it.

askMaya.question: What does ending someone's leave policy do to the leave they have left, and when would HR do it?

override_count.hint: How many kinds of leave were changed for this person on their own. Editing the policy will not move them — those rules stay until you undo them.

askMaya.question: When should an employee's leave rules differ from their policy, and how do those differences get undone?

effective_to.hint: The last day this policy applies, that day included. Balances are kept as they are, no leave can be applied for after it, and monthly leave stops being added.

askMaya.question: What happens to an employee's leave balance and their future leave when their leave policy is given an end date?

organization.setup_checklist.description: The operational readiness checklist — Setup › Organisation setup (OrgSetupChecklistPage) and the SetupChecklistCard nudge on the HR dashboard. Contract: md_organization/7_org_setup_checklist_api.md. Four page-level entries for concepts the screen invents or computes (the page itself, the readiness figure, 'ready to run', what makes a step a must-do), plus one tab.<category_key> per area of the strip, which is the onboarding tier's tab help — the ⓘ beside the strip follows the open tab. Keys match the server's category_key, so an area the server stops sending simply stops being asked for. Nothing is wired per task row: a step's own sentence already says what it is for, and 22 info icons down a list is the noise the cap exists to prevent. HR only: the endpoint is HR_ONLY.

page.hint: What your organisation needs in place before attendance, leave and payroll work. A step counts as done once one of that thing exists.

askMaya.question: What does an HR admin have to set up before attendance, leave and payroll will work in HR Clouds, and what order should those steps be done in?

readiness_percentage.hint: The share of setup steps that are done. It can fall again: delete the last of something and the step that needed it goes back to outstanding.

askMaya.question: How is the organisation setup percentage worked out, and why can it go down after I have already completed a step?

is_operational.hint: Yes once every must-do step is done — the point at which attendance and payroll can run. Optional steps left over don’t hold it back.

askMaya.question: What does it mean for an organisation to be ready to run, and which setup steps decide it?

is_core.hint: A step attendance or payroll can’t work without. Skip one and hours don’t add up or people are left out of a pay run, with no error shown.

askMaya.question: Which organisation setup steps are essential rather than optional, and what goes wrong if an essential one is skipped?

tab.organization.hint: The company’s own record, where people work, how they’re grouped and who approves for whom. Requests have nobody to go to until this is set.

askMaya.question: Why does HR Clouds need offices, departments and reporting lines before leave and attendance requests will work?

tab.attendance.hint: Working days, the shifts people are on, and the rules applied to a day. Until these exist, clock-ins can’t be turned into hours worked.

askMaya.question: What has to be set up in HR Clouds before clock-ins can be turned into hours worked?

tab.leave.hint: The kinds of leave people can take, how much they get, and who has been given them. Nobody can request leave until a type reaches them.

askMaya.question: What has to be in place before an employee can request leave in HR Clouds?

tab.payroll.hint: What a salary is made of, PF, ESI and tax, and the accounts money is paid into. Anyone without a salary structure is skipped by a pay run.

askMaya.question: What does an organisation need in place before it can run its first payroll in HR Clouds?

tab.document.hint: What you collect from your people and what you issue to them. A letter can’t be raised until a template for it exists.

askMaya.question: How do document types and letter templates work in HR Clouds, and what do I need before I can issue a letter?

tab.task.hint: Rules for work you hand out and reminders for work running late. Nothing else in setup waits on this one.

askMaya.question: What are task rules and overdue reminders in HR Clouds, and when would an organisation need them?

organization.profile_setup.description: An HR filling in their own job profile (md_organization/4_org_employee_api.md §11). The person who registers an organisation is created before it has any offices or departments, so their record starts blank and nobody else can fill it. Every field is fill-once, which is why the help says where each one lands rather than how to pick a value. HR only: the endpoints are 403 for everyone else.

page.hint: Your own staff details. Each can be set only once, because payroll, leave and your length of service are all worked out from them.

askMaya.question: Why can I only set my own job details once, and who can correct them afterwards?

joining_date.hint: Your first day. Until it is here you cannot be given a leave policy and payroll leaves you out, so it has to be the real date.

askMaya.question: What does my joining date decide about my leave and my pay?

department_id.hint: Puts you in that department's rosters, reports and approvals. It does not make you its head or change who you report to.

askMaya.question: Why does an upload stop part-way if it is left too long, and is anything lost?

document_max_file_size_bytes.hint: The largest file anybody can upload.

askMaya.question: How large should an upload be allowed to be, and what does somebody see if their file is too big?

document_scan_required.hint: Check every upload for viruses before it can be used.

askMaya.question: What does scanning every upload protect the company from, and does it hold anything up?

document_retention_days.hint: How long a document is kept before it is deleted for good.

askMaya.question: How long should an employee’s documents be kept, and what does the law expect?

letter_record_retention_days.hint: How long an issued letter is kept before it is deleted for good.

askMaya.question: How long should a copy of a letter the company issued be kept?

employee_can_delete_verified_documents.hint: Let people delete their own documents even after HR has checked them.

askMaya.question: What are the risks of letting people delete documents HR has already checked?

document_default_verification_required.hint: Have HR check a newly uploaded document before it counts as on file.

askMaya.question: What does it mean for HR to verify a document, and what waits until that is done?

document_offboarding_archive_mode.hint: What happens to somebody’s documents once they have left.

askMaya.question: What should happen to somebody’s documents once they have left the company?

document_offboarding_exit_pack_scope.hint: Which documents go into the pack a leaver is given.

askMaya.question: What is an exit pack, and what should go into one?

document_acknowledgement_due_days.hint: How long somebody has to confirm they have read a document.

askMaya.question: What does it mean for an employee to acknowledge a document, and why is it recorded?

document_acknowledgement_blocking.hint: Hold other steps up until the person confirms they have read it.

askMaya.question: What should be held up until somebody confirms they have read a document?

document_signature_provider.hint: Who handles the signing when a document needs a signature.

askMaya.question: What is an e-signature provider, and is a document signed that way valid?

document_expiry_reminder_days.hint: How many days before a document runs out the reminders go out.

askMaya.question: Which employee documents run out, and how much warning should people get?

document_notify_hr_on_upload.hint: Tell HR whenever somebody uploads a document.

askMaya.question: Should HR hear about every document somebody uploads, or only some of them?

document_notify_expiry.hint: Tell people when one of their documents is about to run out.

askMaya.question: What should an employee do when one of their documents is about to run out?

document_notify_pending_acknowledgement.hint: Chase people who haven’t confirmed they read a document.

askMaya.question: How often should people be chased to confirm they have read a document?

document_notify_request_raised.hint: Tell somebody as soon as a document is asked of them.

document_notify_request_overdue.hint: Chase people whose document is past the date it was asked for.

askMaya.question: What should happen when a document somebody was asked for is late?

document_notify_letter_issued.hint: Tell somebody when a letter has been issued to them.

askMaya.question: Should somebody be told as soon as a letter is issued to them?

document_request_default_due_days.hint: How long people are given to send in a document that is asked of them.

document_onboarding_completeness_thresho.hint: How much of their document list a new joiner must send to be done.

askMaya.question: How much of their document list should a new joiner have sent before onboarding counts as done?

document_publish_sync_threshold.hint: How many documents are published on the spot before the rest are queued.

askMaya.question: What is the difference for the reader between a document published at once and one that is queued?

letter_branding_enabled.hint: Print letters on the company letterhead.

askMaya.question: What should a company letterhead carry on an official letter?

letter_reference_pattern.hint: The shape of the reference number printed on every letter.

askMaya.question: What is a letter reference number for, and how should it be shaped?

letter_default_confidential.hint: Mark a new letter confidential unless somebody says otherwise.

askMaya.question: What does marking a letter confidential change about who can see it?

letter_requires_acknowledgement_default.hint: Ask the person to confirm they have read a new letter.

askMaya.question: When should a letter ask the person to confirm they have read it?

letter_auto_issue_on_exit.hint: Issue the leaving letters on their own once an exit is finalised.

askMaya.question: Which letters does somebody leaving usually need, and when should they get them?

letter_bulk_max_subjects.hint: How many people one bulk letter run may cover.

askMaya.question: Why limit how many people one bulk letter run can cover?

letter_bulk_rate_per_hour.hint: How many bulk letter runs may be started in an hour.

askMaya.question: Why is the number of bulk letter runs limited per hour?

letter_preview_rate_per_hour.hint: How many letter previews one person may ask for in an hour.

askMaya.question: Why is previewing a letter limited, and what counts as a preview?

letterhead_enabled.hint: Draw the company letterhead on letters and payslips.

askMaya.question: What is a letterhead, and which company documents should carry one?

signatory_name.hint: The name printed under the signature on official letters.

askMaya.question: Who in a company should sign its official letters?

signatory_designation.hint: The job title printed under that name.

askMaya.question: Why is a job title printed under a signature on an official letter?

registered_address_lines.hint: The registered address printed on letters. Up to five lines.

askMaya.question: What is a registered address, and why does it have to appear on official letters?

cin.hint: The company registration number printed on official letters.

askMaya.question: What is a company registration number, and which documents have to show it?

gstin.hint: The company’s GST number, printed on official letters.

askMaya.question: What is a GST number, and why would it appear on a company letter?

pan.hint: The company’s PAN, printed on official letters.

askMaya.question: What is a company PAN, and where is it used?

tan.hint: The company’s TAN, printed on tax letters.

askMaya.question: What is a TAN, and why does it appear on tax letters?

contact_email.hint: The email address printed on letters for people to reply to.

askMaya.question: Which address should people reply to when they get a letter from the company?

contact_phone.hint: The phone number printed on letters.

askMaya.question: Which phone number belongs on a company’s official letters?

website.hint: The company website printed on letters.

askMaya.question: Why print the company website on an official letter?

accent_color_hex.hint: The colour used for the lines and headings on the letterhead.

footer_note.hint: A line printed at the foot of every letter.
